nodes.speaker: Keeper
pages: The underworld stirs beneath these halls.

nodes.speaker: Keeper
pages: The eastern gate drinks the old dark. Bring light, or bring speed.

nodes.speaker: Keeper
pages: Thin the soldier patrol, then bring me a coin from the floor. Do this and I will pay in elixirs.

nodes.speaker: Elder
pages: You crossed the arena few return from. The dark keeps its gate open for you now.
Rest, trade with the keeper, or simply breathe. The underworld is yours to walk.

objectives.description: Reach the sanctuary beyond the arena.
